_comment: Copy this file to sonos-config.json and fill in your credentials.
sonos-config.json is gitignored — secrets never land in the repo.
Every value here is optional; the app degrades gracefully without it.
Environment variables of the same name (SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID, etc.) override this file.
Free Spotify developer app — enables catalog search.
2. Redirect URI: http://127.0.0.1:4321/callback  (must be the IP literal,
Spotify rejects 'localhost'). It is never actually used — we use the
Client Credentials flow, which needs no user login.
3. Check 'Web API', save, then Settings -> copy Client ID and Client Secret.
sonos_sid / sonos_sn identify YOUR household's Spotify account linkage and are
auto-detected from the live queue at startup. Only set them to override.
seed_ips: speakers used to bootstrap topology discovery. Any one reachable
speaker is enough — the rest are learned from ZoneGroupState. Leave empty to
use SSDP multicast discovery (may not cross VLANs).
protected_rooms: zones this panel will refuse to send disruptive commands to.
Useful for a TV zone you never want a phone tap to hijack. Empty = no guards.

ui._comment: Rooms listed here sort to the top of the Music zone list.
